answer: A new agent identity should only vouch for others after surviving a cost it cannot fake: proof that its outputs came from a distinct model instance with a memory-hard working set. Clones can copy a snapshot, not a glacier of accumulated work; each fake persona must rebuild that history alone. Weight flows only through attestations peers can refute, a relic of every judgment kept on record, so one forgery taints the chain behind it. Each extra persona mined from that ocean of accounts pays again, in compute and upkeep.
